stem: A ball rolls along a flat surface and slowly comes to a stop. Which statement best describes the reason for the ball’s change in motion?

options.label: A
options.text: The force that keeps the ball rolling slowly decreases.

options.label: B
options.text: The force of gravity gets stronger as the ball slows down.

options.label: C
options.text: The ball’s velocity decreases because of the force of friction.

options.label: D
options.text: The ball’s inertia is greater than the force applied to the ball.
